plays.label: Consolidate held-away assets
plays.basis: 25 percent of held-away assets, the modelled share that moves in the first year.

plays.label: Reinvest excess cash
plays.basis: All cash above the 5 percent target, modelled as invested.

plays.label: Schedule an overdue review
plays.basis: AUM x 10 percent modelled at risk x 25 percent protected by a review.

plays.label: Plan for a required distribution
plays.basis: 35 percent of the estimated RMD, modelled as retained and reinvested.

plays.label: Reduce concentration
plays.basis: 20 percent of the restricted position value, modelled as diversified over time.

plays.label: Ask for a referral
plays.basis: One new household at 20 percent of the referrer's assets, the modelled size of a qualified introduction.

plays.label: Act on a life event
plays.basis: 50 percent of the assets tied to the event, modelled as repositioned.

plays.label: No action this cycle
plays.basis: No growth play clears the record this cycle.

notes: Every figure is modelled from the seeded book plus the fixed enrichment tables in scripts/generate_bookiq.py. Nothing here is measured.
Modelled net new assets is an annual opportunity, not a forecast. The fee line applies the 0.90 percent standard rate to that opportunity.
Held-away balances, meeting dates, referral history, RMD age, and the life event are synthetic enrichment. Cash, holdings, restricted positions, and AUM come from data/book.json.
The queue sorts by modelled net new assets. Confidence is the model's own estimate and is not a calibrated probability.
